review.body: { if recorded . recipe != DEPENDENCY_RECIPE { return Err (ProfileError :: Recipe) ; } if dependency_commitment (id , p , salt , list) ? != * recorded { return Err (ProfileError :: Mismatch) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: The typed operation retains its public carrier or secret-container boundary; opening publication is explicit and never authenticates the retained anchor.
